text:
olivia - Support: Hey team — escalated from Sam (customer). They enabled dynamic batching on the embeddings endpoint and now see intermittent 400 errors and big tail latency spikes. Sam says this started after changing max_batch_size from 64 -> 256 and turning on dynamic batching.

sam - Customer: repro steps I used:
1) POST /v1/embeddings with model=open-embedding-1
2) send 150 concurrent short texts (~25 tokens)
3) headers: Authorization: Bearer <key>
4) body: {"input":[..150..]}

Result: about ~3% of requests get 400 DimensionMismatch and many requests have p99 > 2s (used to be ~120ms).

sam - Customer: sample error payload: ```json
{
  "error":{"code":400,"message":"DimensionMismatch: expected 1536 but model returned 1024","trace_id":"trc_9f2c..."}
}```

olivia - Support: Got the trace_id, thanks. Can you also paste the response headers (X-Request-Id / X-Model-Version) if available? Any chance you switched to a different model family?

sam - Customer: headers: X-Request-Id: rq_8a1b..., X-Model-Version: open-embedding-1-1.2. Sam: nope we didn't change the model in code, only the batching config in console.

deploy-bot: deploy finished: runtime-config update id cfg_3345 (actor: sam.team)

jamal - eng-runtime: pinging in. DimensionMismatch usually means either model variant mismatch or request chunking is changing batch flattening. Dynamic batching can coalesce requests from different model versions? It shouldn't. Can you share the exact runtime config (max_batch_size, batching_window_ms, dynamic_batching: true)?

sam - Customer: runtime config: {max_batch_size: 256, batching_window_ms: 5, dynamic_batching: true, concurrency_limit: 512}

ting - eng-ml: quick theory: if some requests are hitting a different model variant (e.g., quantized 1024-dim variant) due to fallback routing, coalescing could accidentally mix dims during aggregation and trigger validation. Also large max_batch_size + tiny batching window can create uneven packing and memory pressure -> kernel fallback causing slower tails.

jamal - eng-runtime: Two immediate repro checks: 1) try disabling dynamic_batching (set false) and keep max_batch_size large, see if 400 goes away; 2) set max_batch_size=1 as sanity-check (no batching). If both fix it, it's almost certainly a batching aggregation bug.

olivia - Support: Sam, can you run those two quick tests? If you prefer we can flip on a temporary routing rule to pin to a single model version for your tenant.

sam - Customer: Ran quick tests:
- dynamic_batching=false, max_batch_size=256 -> errors drop to 0, p99~140ms (good)
- dynamic_batching=true, max_batch_size=1 -> errors 0 but p99 ~400ms (worse latency)

sam - Customer: So looks like dynamic_batching=true + max_batch_size>1 is the combo that triggers it.

jamal - eng-runtime: That's a smoking gun. Thanks. Could you also provide a small capture of the request bodies (sanitized) for a batch that failed? We want to check shapes/embedding consistency at the server side.

sam - Customer: attaching snippet (sanitized): ```json
{"input":["hello","hi","quick test", ... 150 items]}
```

ting - eng-ml: I'll take a look at the model registry. It's possible we have two builds for open-embedding-1 in the fleet: a 1536-dim and a 1024-dim (old quantized) both labeled similarly. If routing occasionally picks the other build, batching code must validate per-item dims before packing.

jamal - eng-runtime: I found related logs for trace_id trc_9f2c... in infra: batch assemble failed -> dimension mismatch logged inside assembly step. Patching hypothesis: when coalescing, we pull model metadata from the first request only, then assume all recips match. If routing changed mid-assembly (rare race), mismatch.

maria - Support Manager: assign to eng-runtime for an immediate hotfix and eng-ml for model registry cleanup. SLA impact: customer on Dedicated, medium-high. Keep them updated.

jamal - eng-runtime: Action plan: 1) short-term mitigation: change default batching behavior for dedicated tenants to validate per-request model_id before packing and reject mismatched ones (fast patch). 2) longer-term: enforce model_id in the routing key for coalescing so only identical-model requests batch. 3) add metric and alert for DimensionMismatch during batch assemble.

jamal - eng-runtime: For workaround you can tell Sam to set dynamic_batching=false (we saw that stops errors) or lower max_batch_size to 32 and increase batching_window_ms to 10-20ms so coalescing happens less opportunistically. That tends to reduce tail spikes too.

ting - eng-ml: Also will audit model registry tags. If any two builds share same public model name but different dims, that's the root cause. We'll drop ambiguous aliases and add a model-version header in responses.

olivia - Support: Sam — would you like us to apply a pin to your tenant so you always hit build open-embedding-1-1.2 while we fix this?

sam - Customer: Yes please — pin to open-embedding-1-1.2. Also if you can confirm the workaround setting (max_batch_size=32 & batching_window_ms=15) would be ideal.

olivia - Support: done — pin applied to your tenant (cfg pin_778). Also updated runtime to max_batch_size=32, batching_window_ms=15 for your tenant. Please monitor and report back in ~30m.

deploy-bot: routing-rule update: pin applied pin_778 (actor: olivia)

sam - Customer: after 25m: errors -> 0, p99 ~180ms. Much better. Thanks! :tada:

jamal - eng-runtime: Creating a small hotfix PR to validate model_id at pack-time and add a metric: dim_mismatch_assemble_count. We'll roll to canary immediately.

jamal - eng-runtime: PR: https://git.internal/r/infra/patches/1234 (canary rolling now).

ting - eng-ml: I'll run registry cleanup and add a warning when model alias maps to multiple dims.

olivia - Support: I'll follow up with Sam after 24h and ensure billing/keys unaffected. Logging the case: CS-#5921.

maria - Support Manager: Good triage. Please add postmortem if hotfix rolls to stable. Assign to eng-runtime and eng-ml for follow-up.

olivia - Support: Closing loop for now — moving to follow-up channel once hotfix done. Thanks everyone. :heart:
